authorization: Bounded user-authorized two-candidate full-Train E79 inference benchmark. This is a new exploratory benchmark and does not revise or retroactively pass earlier gates.

historical_decisions_preserved.REG_POSITION_DIRECT_L1_V1: historical development gates remain unchanged and failed
historical_decisions_preserved.R06_public_reference: R06_ORIGINAL public MAE 11.16620; receipt-linked final mapped prediction

anchor.mapping: Use manifest-bound final prediction, already mapped once by average-tie rank50 per complete Test cycle; never use raw_candidate as the baseline.

data.test_label_boundary: Test labels are never read. Test features are opened only after each candidate's trained-state freeze and independent prelabel pass.

fit_order_and_cap.unit_reconciliation: Candidate A: one ranker plus four preprocessing units. Candidate B: one regressor plus one full-Train shared word TF-IDF state and three structured preprocessing units. Position and unigram blocks are transforms from that one exact shared state. Total: two predictors plus eight preprocessing units. Any additional learned call blocks the batch.

candidate_A.training: All official Train rows through cycle 79; stable same-cycle LambdaRank groups; grades clip(floor(threat_rank/10),0,9); exact saved R12 parameters; no validation or early stopping.
candidate_A.preprocessing: Exact R12 word TF-IDF and structured processor, scaler, and OHE recipe fit on all Train rows.
candidate_A.policy: present: clip(0.75*CURRENT_R06_E79_final_mapped + 0.25*100*averageRank(raw_R12 within complete Test cycle)/complete_cycle_n,0,100); missing signal_stream: exact CURRENT_R06_E79 final mapped prediction.

candidate_B.training: All official Train rows through cycle 79, direct threat_rank target, exact REAL-only L1 recipe and original regularized LightGBM parameters; no BAG/SHUFFLED arm or parameter change.
candidate_B.features: Exact structured features plus L2 unigram bag, original three-third REAL position block built with shared IDF, and missing-text indicator. One full-Train target-free word TF-IDF state is used for both text blocks; no additional fit for position transforms.
candidate_B.policy: aux_rank50=0.5*raw_aux+0.5*100*averageRank(raw_aux within complete Test cycle)/complete_cycle_n; present: clip(0.75*CURRENT_R06_E79_final_mapped+0.25*aux_rank50,0,100); missing signal_stream: exact CURRENT_R06_E79 final mapped prediction. Rank the full cycle before applying missing mask.
